body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#784, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
Adopters file issues, add workarounds or holds tagged with the issue number, and later upgrade. When the fix lands, nothing prompts them to remove the workaround, so bypasses and holds outlive the fix by days or weeks.

## Proposal
`corvint changes --from <build-sha> --to <build-sha> [--refs-file FILE]`:
- list the issues and PRs closed between two builds, with a one-line summary and any new flags or commands;
- given a file or glob of adopter text (configs, prompts, scripts), report every `#NNN` reference whose issue is now closed in the target build: "workaround may be removable".

## Acceptance criteria
- Deterministic output from build metadata, with no network access when the source checkout is present.
- References to closed issues are listed with file:line and the closing PR.

title: Upgrade adoption checklist: issues closed between two installed builds, keyed to adopter workarounds (GitHub #784)
